## Load data

```{r}
sxh_tp <- load_data("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TefEasY2RvEZcJvYqRwCXOg8e4aFtaf_0v5Gc6ftr-o/edit?usp=sharing",
                     sheet = "sxh_tp")

sxh_qh <- load_data("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TefEasY2RvEZcJvYqRwCXOg8e4aFtaf_0v5Gc6ftr-o/edit?usp=sharing",
                     sheet = "sxh_qh")

tcm_tp <- load_data("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TefEasY2RvEZcJvYqRwCXOg8e4aFtaf_0v5Gc6ftr-o/edit?usp=sharing",
                     sheet = "tcm_tp")

tcm_qh <- load_data("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TefEasY2RvEZcJvYqRwCXOg8e4aFtaf_0v5Gc6ftr-o/edit?usp=sharing",
                     sheet = "tcm_qh")

## Population density
pop <- load_data("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sQ1bWkLqF136PO5MfjtRCB9q0d_Krew54AM7sX69Pr4/edit?usp=sharing", sheet = "Tổng")
```

## Dengue - City

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
rs2018 <- run_algos_city(sxh_tp, 2018)
rs2019 <- run_algos_city(sxh_tp, 2019)
rs2020 <- run_algos_city(sxh_tp, 2020)
rs2022 <- run_algos_city(sxh_tp, 2022)
rs2023 <- run_algos_city(sxh_tp, 2023)
rs2024 <- run_algos_city(sxh_tp, 2024)

all_res <- bind_rows(rs2018, rs2019, rs2020, rs2022, rs2023, rs2024)

summary_alarms <- all_res %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("ub_"), 
    names_to = "algorithm", 
    values_to = "threshold"
  ) %>%
  mutate(is_alarm = if_else(!is.na(threshold) & cases >= threshold, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(year, algorithm) %>%
  summarise(total_weeks_alarm = sum(is_alarm), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(algorithm = str_remove(algorithm, "ub_")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = algorithm, 
    values_from = total_weeks_alarm
  )  
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
all_res_long <- all_res %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 5:23,
               values_to = "values",
               names_to = "variables")

labels <- c(
  "ub_cdc" = "CDC",
  "ub_rki1" = "RKI1",
  "ub_rki2" = "RKI2",
  "ub_bayes1" = "Bayes1",
  "ub_bayes2" = "Bayes2",
  "ub_far_old" = "Farrington",
  "ub_far_flex" = "Farrington Flexible",
  "ub_earsC1" = "EARS C1",
  "ub_earsC2" = "EARS C2",
  "ub_earsC3" = "EARS C3",
  "ub_glrnb" = "GLR Negbin",
  "ub_glrpois" = "GLR Poisson",
  "ub_cusum" = "CUSUM",
  "ub_cusum_rossi" = "CUSUM Rossi",
  "ub_cusum_rossiGLM" = "CUSUM Rossi fit GLM",
  "ub_cusum_negbin" = "CUSUM Negbin",
  "ub_cusum_negbinGLM" = "CUSUM Negbin fit GLM",
  "ub_serfling" = "Serfling",
  "ub_mem" = "MEM"
)

pdf("charts_dengue.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)

unique_years <- unique(all_res_long$year)

for (y in unique_years) {
  p <- all_res_long %>% 
    filter(year == y) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = week)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = cases), fill = "grey80", width = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(y = values), color = "red") +
    facet_wrap(~variables,
               labeller = labeller(variables = labels),
               scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black")) +
    labs(x = "Weeks", y = "Cases", title = paste("Year:", y))
  
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```

## Dengue - Districts

```{r}
d2018 <- run_algos_by_district(sxh_qh, 2018)
d2019 <- run_algos_by_district(sxh_qh, 2019)
d2020 <- run_algos_by_district(sxh_qh, 2020)
d2022 <- run_algos_by_district(sxh_qh, 2022)
d2023 <- run_algos_by_district(sxh_qh, 2023)
d2024 <- run_algos_by_district(sxh_qh, 2024)

all_res_districts <- bind_rows(d2018, d2019, d2020, d2022, d2023, d2024)

summary_alarms_districts <- all_res_districts %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("ub_"), 
    names_to = "algorithm", 
    values_to = "threshold"
  ) %>%
  mutate(is_alarm = if_else(!is.na(threshold) & cases >= threshold, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(year, districts, algorithm) %>% 
  summarise(total_weeks_alarm = sum(is_alarm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

summary_alarms_districts <- summary_alarms_districts %>% 
    mutate(districts = recode(districts,
    "bc"   = "Bình Chánh",
    "bt"   = "Bình Thạnh",
    "bta"  = "Bình Tân",
    "cc"   = "Củ Chi",
    "cg"   = "Cần Giờ",
    "gv"   = "Gò Vấp",
    "hm"   = "Hóc Môn",
    "nb"   = "Nhà Bè",
    "pn"   = "Phú Nhuận",
    "q1"   = "Quận 1",
    "q10"  = "Quận 10",
    "q11"  = "Quận 11",
    "q12"  = "Quận 12",
    "q3"   = "Quận 3",
    "q4"   = "Quận 4",
    "q5"   = "Quận 5",
    "q6"   = "Quận 6",
    "q7"   = "Quận 7",
    "q8"   = "Quận 8",
    "tb"   = "Tân Bình",
    "tp"   = "Tân Phú",
    "tptd" = "Thành phố Thủ Đức"
  ))
```

```{r}
pop_2018 <- pop %>% 
  filter(year == 2019) %>% 
  mutate(year = 2018)

pop_2022 <- pop %>% 
  filter(year == 2023) %>% 
  mutate(year = 2022)

pop_final <- bind_rows(pop, pop_2018, pop_2022) %>% 
  arrange(districts, year)
```

```{r}
df_final <- summary_alarms_districts %>%
  left_join(pop_final, by = c("year", "districts"))

labels <- c(
  "ub_cdc" = "CDC",
  "ub_rki1" = "RKI1",
  "ub_rki2" = "RKI2",
  "ub_bayes1" = "Bayes1",
  "ub_bayes2" = "Bayes2",
  "ub_far_old" = "Farrington",
  "ub_far_flex" = "Farrington Flexible",
  "ub_earsC1" = "EARS C1",
  "ub_earsC2" = "EARS C2",
  "ub_earsC3" = "EARS C3",
  "ub_glrnb" = "GLR Negbin",
  "ub_glrpois" = "GLR Poisson",
  "ub_cusum" = "CUSUM",
  "ub_cusum_rossi" = "CUSUM Rossi",
  "ub_cusum_rossiGLM" = "CUSUM Rossi fit GLM",
  "ub_cusum_negbin" = "CUSUM Negbin",
  "ub_cusum_negbinGLM" = "CUSUM Negbin fit GLM",
  "ub_serfling" = "Serfling",
  "ub_mem" = "MEM"
)

df_final <- df_final %>%
  mutate(dist_abbr = case_match(districts,
  
    "Quận 1" ~ "Q1", "Quận 3" ~ "Q3", "Quận 4" ~ "Q4", 
    "Quận 5" ~ "Q5", "Quận 6" ~ "Q6", "Quận 7" ~ "Q7", 
    "Quận 8" ~ "Q8", "Quận 10" ~ "Q10", "Quận 11" ~ "Q11", 
    "Quận 12" ~ "Q12",
    
    "Bình Thạnh" ~ "BT",
    "Bình Tân"   ~ "BTA",
    "Gò Vấp"     ~ "GV",
    "Phú Nhuận"  ~ "PN",
    "Tân Bình"   ~ "TB",
    "Tân Phú"    ~ "TP",
    "Thành phố Thủ Đức" ~ "TD",
    
    # Nhóm Huyện
    "Bình Chánh" ~ "BC",
    "Cần Giờ"    ~ "CG",
    "Củ Chi"     ~ "CC",
    "Hóc Môn"    ~ "HM",
    "Nhà Bè"     ~ "NB"))

pdf("charts_dengue_districts.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)

unique_years <- unique(df_final$year)

for (y in unique_years) {
  
  p <- df_final %>% 
    filter(year == y) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = popd, y = total_weeks_alarm)) +
    geom_point(color = "firebrick", alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = dist_abbr), 
                    size = 3,          
                    box.padding = 0.5, 
                    max.overlaps = Inf,
                    segment.size = 0.2,       
                    segment.color = "grey70", 
                    segment.alpha = 0.6
                    ) +

    facet_wrap(~algorithm, scales = "fixed",
               labeller = labeller(algorithm = labels)) + 
    
    scale_x_log10(labels = comma) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black")) +

    labs(x = "Population Density (Logarit)", 
         y = "Alarm weeks", 
         title = paste("Year:", y))
  
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```

```{r}
dist_levels <- df_final %>% 
  filter(year == 2019) %>% 
  arrange(popd) %>%         
  pull(dist_abbr) %>%       
  unique()

df_final$dist_abbr <- factor(df_final$dist_abbr, levels = dist_levels)

pdf("charts_dengue_heatmap.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)

unique_years <- unique(df_final$year)

for (y in unique_years) {
  
  data_plot <- df_final %>% filter(year == y)
  
  p <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = dist_abbr, y = algorithm)) +
    
    geom_tile(aes(fill = total_weeks_alarm), color = "white", size = 0.5) +
    
    geom_text(aes(label = total_weeks_alarm), size = 3, color = "black") +
    
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#ebf5fb", high = "#c0392b", na.value = "grey90") +
    
    scale_y_discrete(labels = labels) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = "Districts (Low to High Population Density)",
         y = "",
         fill = "Alarm weeks",
         title = paste("Year:", y)) +
    
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(), 
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```
